description: The Northern Light did a good profile on the candidates when Erika ran for Blaine School Board in 2021.Erika Creydt has three kids who have attended Blaine schools in the past. Creydt said her kids switched to an online schooling program because of the Covid-19 pandemic.Creydt is a psychologist and clinical director of TouchStone Health Clinic in downtown Blaine.
